correctness.rationale: For independent Y1,Y2~XLindley(theta), let Ni|Yi~Poisson(Yi) independently. Conditional Poisson additivity proves N in law equals N1+N2 and G_PTS(z)=G_PXL(z)^2. The source’s exact squared PGF confirms identity. Mixed-Poisson total variance Var N=E(Y1+Y2)+Var(Y1+Y2)>EN for any nondegenerate finite theta, so DI>1. Independent symbolic algebra confirmed printed rational formula DI(theta)-1=(theta^4+4theta^3+8theta^2+8theta+2)/(theta(1+theta)^2(theta^2+2theta+2))>0 and EN~2/theta as theta→infinity; dispersion approaches 1 only as mean tends to 0. Holds theta>0, not an assertion about observed sample dispersion.
